scope: Identical prior carry and token inputs; legacy packed versus diagnostic FP32 dense storage. No model quality measured.

observations.ptx_reduction: Old uses shfl16 plus shared-memory cross-warp reduction; dense uses within-warp shfl8/4/2/1. Multiply/add fusion differs with reduction tree.
observations.inference: The observed readout-only drift is consistent with the different reduction/fusion order. Exact FP32 elementwise recurrence was not instrumented independently; all 17 persisted decoded carries are bitwise equal.
